era: The NWS weather.gov design in use since 2013 and seen by everyone in 2019 (NOAA/NWS banner header, blue horizontal menu, US hazards map home, MapClick point forecast with Current conditions / Extended Forecast / Detailed Forecast / Additional Forecasts and Information, office pages with left-hand menus). 2019-03/07/11 home HTML, 2019-02/12 OKX office HTML and a 2019-11 point forecast agree with today's site.
